title: Quercetin Attenuates Cytokine Storm in Viral Pneumonia via Inhibition of the TLR3-NF-kappaB-IL-6 Signaling Axis.
authors: Zhou, Yiqun; Chen, Yu; Shen, Yanping; Wang, Yan; Lu, Yanwu
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素通过TLR3-NF-κB-IL-6轴抑制病毒性肺炎细胞因子风暴，虽含分子对接但核心为炎症信号通路与湿实验验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Cytokine storm is a critical determinant of mortality in viral pneumonia. The TLR3-NF-kappaB signaling pathway mediates excessive inflammatory responses, with IL-6 as a key effector molecule. This study aimed to identify natural compounds capable of attenuating cytokine storm through modulation of this signaling axis. Network pharmacology was employed to screen active components from Houttuynia cordata and identify therapeutic targets for viral pneumonia. Molecular docking evaluated binding affinities between candidate compounds and core targets. A Poly(I:C)-induced inflammatory model in human bronchial epithelial BEAS-2B cells was established to validate protective effects and molecular mechanisms. Post-treatment experiments were conducted to evaluate therapeutic (vs. preventive) efficacy of quercetin. siRNA-mediated knockdown of TLR3 and TRIF was performed to verify pathway dependence. An epithelial-macrophage (BEAS-2B/THP-1) co-culture model and primary normal human bronchial epithelial (NHBE) cells were employed to enhance physiological relevance. Cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) was used to confirm direct target engagement of quercetin with NF-kappaB p65 and TLR3. Comparative experiments with other Houttuynia cordata flavonoids (isorhamnetin and kaempferol) were conducted to validate the unique contribution of quercetin. Among nine active components of Houttuynia cordata, quercetin exhibited the highest number of targets (142) with 13 intersection genes shared with viral pneumonia disease targets. Molecular docking demonstrated favorable binding of quercetin to NF-kappaB p65 (-7.7 kcal/mol) and TLR3 (-6.3 kcal/mol). Quercetin dose-dependently restored cell viability, maintained epithelial barrier integrity, inhibited apoptosis, and suppressed IL-6, TNF-alpha, and IFN-beta expression. Mechanistically, quercetin inhibited TLR3 and TRIF expression, reduced IkappaBalpha phosphorylation, blocked p65 nuclear translocation, and decreased p65 binding to the IL6 promoter kappaB site. Rescue experiments confirmed NF-kappaB p65 as a key therapeutic target. Post-treatment experiments demonstrated that quercetin administered after Poly(I:C) stimulation (Post-0h, Post-2h, Post-6h) retained significant anti-inflammatory and barrier-protective effects in a time-dependent manner, supporting therapeutic rather than solely preventive efficacy. siRNA knockdown of TLR3 or TRIF abolished Poly(I:C)-induced inflammatory responses and eliminated the additional inhibitory effect of quercetin, genetically confirming pathway dependence. In the BEAS-2B/THP-1 co-culture system, epithelial-macrophage crosstalk amplified inflammatory cytokine levels by 2-3 fold compared with monoculture, yet quercetin still significantly attenuated this amplified cytokine storm and reversed THP-1 M1 polarization. These findings were further validated in primary NHBE cells. CETSA confirmed direct binding of quercetin to p65 (DeltaTm = +4.3 degrees C) and TLR3 (DeltaTm = +3.3 degrees C) in intact cells. Comparative experiments showed that quercetin exhibited significantly superior anti-inflammatory efficacy over isorhamnetin and kaempferol at equimolar concentrations. Quercetin attenuates cytokine storm in viral pneumonia through multi-target inhibition of the TLR3-NF-kappaB-IL-6 signaling axis, with both preventive and therapeutic efficacy demonstrated in epithelial monoculture, epithelial-macrophage co-culture, and primary cell models. Genetic knockdown and CETSA experiments provide direct evidence for pathway specificity and target engagement, providing scientific evidence for the clinical application of Houttuynia cordata.
abstract_zh: 细胞因子风暴是病毒性肺炎死亡的关键决定因素。TLR3-NF-kappaB信号通路介导过度炎症反应，其中IL-6是关键效应分子。本研究旨在鉴定能够通过调节该信号轴来减轻细胞因子风暴的天然化合物。采用网络药理学方法从鱼腥草中筛选活性成分，并识别病毒性肺炎的治疗靶点。分子对接评估了候选化合物与核心靶点之间的结合亲和力。建立人支气管上皮BEAS-2B细胞中Poly(I:C)诱导的炎症模型，以验证保护效应及分子机制。进行治疗后实验以评估槲皮素的治疗（而非预防）功效。通过siRNA介导的TLR3和TRIF敲低来验证通路依赖性。采用上皮-巨噬细胞（BEAS-2B/THP-1）共培养模型和原代人正常支气管上皮（NHBE）细胞以增强生理相关性。使用细胞热位移分析（CETSA）确认槲皮素与NF-kappaB p65和TLR3的直接靶点结合。与鱼腥草其他黄酮类化合物（异鼠李素和山奈酚）的比较实验用于验证槲皮素的独特贡献。在鱼腥草的九种活性成分中，槲皮素表现出最多的靶点数（142个），与病毒性肺炎疾病靶点共享13个交集基因。分子对接显示槲皮素与NF-kappaB p65（-7.7 kcal/mol）和TLR3（-6.3 kcal/mol）具有良好的结合亲和力。槲皮素剂量依赖性地恢复细胞活力、维持上皮屏障完整性、抑制凋亡，并抑制IL-6、TNF-alpha和IFN-beta的表达。机制上，槲皮素抑制TLR3和TRIF表达，减少IkappaBalpha磷酸化，阻断p65核转位，并降低p65与IL6启动子kappaB位点的结合。救援实验确认NF-kappaB p65是关键治疗靶点。治疗后实验表明，在Poly(I:C)刺激后给予槲皮素（Post-0h、Post-2h、Post-6h）以时间依赖性方式保留显著的抗炎和屏障保护效应，支持其治疗而非仅预防功效。siRNA敲低TLR3或TRIF消除了Poly(I:C)诱导的炎症反应，并消除了槲皮素的额外抑制效应，从遗传学上确认了通路依赖性。在BEAS-2B/THP-1共培养系统中，上皮-巨噬细胞串扰将炎症细胞因子水平较单培养放大2-3倍，但槲皮素仍显著减轻了这种放大的细胞因子风暴，并逆转了THP-1 M1极化。这些发现在原代NHBE细胞中得到进一步验证。CETSA确认槲皮素在完整细胞中与p65（DeltaTm = +4.3摄氏度）和TLR3（DeltaTm = +3.3摄氏度）直接结合。比较实验显示，在等摩尔浓度下，槲皮素的抗炎功效显著优于异鼠李素和山奈酚。槲皮素通过多靶点抑制TLR3-NF-kappaB-IL-6信号轴来减轻病毒性肺炎中的细胞因子风暴，并在上皮单培养、上皮-巨噬细胞共培养和原代细胞模型中均显示出预防和治疗功效。遗传敲低和CETSA实验为通路特异性和靶点结合提供了直接证据，为鱼腥草的临床应用提供了科学依据。
